_design: The banned-term, retired-value and canon lists used to live as regex literals
inside scripts/gate_landing.py. A scanner that carries its own patterns matches
itself, which forced a file whitelist to suppress the self-hit. Holding the
patterns as data instead means no scanner source contains a pattern, so the
whitelist collapses to this one file.
hard_fail  : unique tokens, no false positives observed. A hit is a FAIL.
hard_fail_landing : hard only on the visitor-facing surface. Several of these
appear legitimately elsewhere -- CHANGELOG_CR.md documents the
75 -> 74 correction and must be able to say '75 papers'.
warn       : context-dependent. These collide with live canonical values
(55.0% ex-cost negative share, 73%/85% audit rates, the '94-107'
page range in the camera-ready bibliography, the 0.640/0.530
example costs in valid/checklist.py). Never promote to FAIL --
a human reads gate_warn.log and judges.
except_files is a LOUD exemption: CHECK B prints every one it applies.
CHANGELOG_CR.md is a retraction log -- it has to be able to quote the claim
it is retracting, so the two entries it quotes are exempt there and nowhere
else. A quiet exemption would be indistinguishable from a missed hit.
except_prefixes is the same idea one level up, and the same risk: nothing
under docs/evidence/ is scanned for B-1. A retired value that only ever
appears in an evidence log is not caught. That is the price of being able
to write down what the gate found.

hard_fail.reason: retired claim: the corpus carries one cost level, not six

hard_fail.except_reason: CHANGELOG_CR.md records the retraction of this very claim and quotes it to do so

hard_fail.unless_near: to our knowledge|to the best of|arguably|among the|one of the|we believe|may be|possibly|appears to be
hard_fail.reason: unqualified priority claim; allowed only behind a hedge
hard_fail.except_reason: CHANGELOG_CR.md records the retraction of this very claim and quotes it to do so

hard_fail_landing.reason: no performance or sales promise on the landing page
pre-E11 n=75 figures; superseded by the n=74 canon

warn.known_false_positive: camera-ready bibliography page range '94-107'. This entry is why the B-1/B-2 split exists: as a hard FAIL it would red the gate on a reference list.
collides with live canonical values: 55.0% ex-cost negative share, 73% D2 rate, 85% D7 rate.
valid/checklist.py and tests/test_checklist.py use it as an API example.

except_prefixes.reason: evidence logs exist to quote what a check found; a gate that cannot be reported on without failing produces no evidence. This is the one directory-wide hole in B-1 and CHECK B prints it on every run.
